summary: P1 wave-2 consumer: re-point the AlembicPlugin recipe-submission gates to validate against the now-shipped @alembic/core/knowledge module (Core a2329ce, P0 accepted and controller-verified byte-identical), proving byte-identical behavior. This is the most dangerous discipline CG-3: gates are RE-SOURCED, not relaxed and not rewritten; if any baseline byte differs after re-pointing, STOP because a value was reinterpreted instead of moved. P1.0 FIRST: capture a golden-corpus behavior baseline BEFORE re-sourcing. Generate a corpus of submissions (one passing plus one failing per reject code) and snapshot every gate current violation output; if the existing handler tests are thin, add lib/runtime/mcp/handlers/recipe-gate-golden-corpus.test.ts on the OLD inline constants first to lock current behavior, then re-point; this baseline is the P1 and P4 oracle. P1.1 stage-1: in lib/runtime/mcp/handlers/recipe-content-quality-gate.ts delete the inline constant and predicate bodies (the verb Sets, regexes, hasMarkerExample, around lines 24-89 and 158-217) and add the file first upward import of validateAgainst from @alembic/core/knowledge, so validateSubmitKnowledgeContentQuality calls validateAgainst(items, stage 1, path host-cold-start) and returns the same violation shape; the tool-router.ts line 163 call site is unchanged; same Set same regex same predicate (the module copies are byte-identical to these originals, controller-verified in P0) means byte-identical output. P1.2 stage-2: in the LIVE lib/recipe-generation/host-agent-workflows/recipe-evidence-gate.ts (NOT the dead lib/runtime/mcp duplicate) delete the inline pure predicates that P0 already lifted into the module (floor table, snippet algo, source-ref format regex, placeholder blacklist, relationship keywords) and call validateAgainst(items, stage 2, path, sourceRefResolver); the Plugin injects the sourceRefResolver and sessionScope ports so the on-disk SOURCE_REF_NOT_FOUND and LINE_OUT_OF_RANGE checks (around lines 528-581) and the bootstrap-session scope stay Plugin-side; shouldRunRecipeEvidenceGate (around 88-110) and the tool-router.ts 172-180 wrapping are unchanged so stage 2 still fires only on cold-start. P1.5: add a per-rule drift tripwire snapshot test on the lifted constants so any future edit that would change gate behavior fails loudly. Acceptance on node 22: the golden-corpus test produces byte-identical violation arrays versus the P1.0 baseline (the discipline gate — any byte difference means STOP); the handler and evidence-gate test suites pass; Plugin build:check green; the drift snapshot green. Ensure the local Core build is current so @alembic/core/knowledge resolves validateAgainst (P0 already built Core dist; rebuild Core if your resolver needs it). Develop on main only, no push or tag or version bump; gates byte-identical and not relaxed; the dead recipe-evidence-gate duplicate is out of scope and must not be touched. Producer-consumer: you consume the shipped Core module; Core stage-3 re-point P1.3 and the in-process parity flatten P1.4 follow as separate waves. Backfill the Plugin commit hash, the golden-corpus byte-identical proof (baseline versus re-pointed), raw test and build:check output, and the delete-inline-plus-import diff. If any baseline byte differs, do NOT massage it green: stop and return needs-review with the diff so the controller can rule whether a value was reinterpreted.
